name: js_new_array_buffer

ownership.argument: Static cross-check of the device-measured array-buffer class id: 19 appears as an immediate here and as 19*8 in the prototype-table offset.

provenance.source: Validates the length against 'invalid array buffer length', allocates a 28-byte JSArrayBuffer through the context malloc hook, stores the byte length at +0, installs the free callback 0xC27369C at +24 and initialises the two list heads at +12/+16, then wraps it with the object constructor 0xC2A167C passing class id 19. The wrapper path also reaches the class prototype at ctx+40 with an offset of 152 = 19*8, which is the same number by a second route. Two callers in the JS binding layer (0xC861308, 0xC8712A4).

notes: Static cross-check of the device-measured array-buffer class id: 19 appears as an immediate here and as 19*8 in the prototype-table offset.
